selected_script.angle: Eliminating cross-contamination and garlic odor transfer onto fresh fruits using a non-porous stainless steel surface
selected_script.hook: Tired of your fresh fruit smelling and tasting like yesterday's chopped garlic?

script_record.pain_point: Cross-contamination of strong garlic odors transferring to sweet fruits on old porous cutting boards.
script_record.conflict_hook: Tired of your fresh fruit smelling and tasting like yesterday's chopped garlic?
script_record.product_solution: The non-porous silver stainless steel chopping board prevents odor absorption, offering a clean, hygienic cutting surface.

timeline.scene: Close-up of a person cutting fresh strawberries on a scratched, old wooden board, then taking a bite and making a grimace of disgust.

timeline.purpose: 荒诞成年亲属携产品入场
timeline.scene: A husband in a tuxedo and swim goggles slides into the kitchen frame holding the silver stainless steel chopping board, places it on the counter, and says, 'Use steel instead!'
The silver stainless steel board is laid flat with its 1cm bent lip hugging the counter edge. Fresh strawberries are sliced cleanly on the non-porous surface.
Water easily rinsing juice off the metallic board, showing it becomes clean and odor-free instantly.
Close-up of slicing fresh green vegetables on the rectangular board under bright kitchen lighting.
A hand easily lifts the board by its 1cm folded lip, displaying a dry and clean countertop underneath.
Text on screen reading 'Upgrade your kitchen prep today.' alongside the clean silver board.
